findings.finding: Backend mutation routes accepted anonymous calls.
findings.resolution: Distinct task/operator bearer scopes, configured-token checks and localhost Docker binding; authorization tests execute without side effects.

findings.affected_requirement: unique applied intervals and atomic background state
findings.finding: Retrying cron advanced the Wild again; cron and worker did not share a durable slot identity.
findings.resolution: Pinned schedule, UTC high-water cursor, unique slot key, atomic state/outcome/candidate/receipt transaction, bounded catch-up and concurrent/restart/crash checks.

findings.finding: No archived Darwin inputs, saved pixel-keeper consequences or Python-to-web snapshot adapter is implemented. The existing Wild is a separate simulated ecosystem.
findings.recommended_resolution: Implement one isolated hourly Darwin garden with pinned environment intervals and versioned keeper events; keep origin and portable v1 behavior intact.
findings.recheck_trigger: Pixel updater, weather collector or snapshot adapter is added.

findings.finding: A hosted schedule and meaningful pre-return pixel changes during 24 hours with all views closed are NOT_ESTABLISHED. The local three-second simulation smoke cannot establish that claim.
findings.recommended_resolution: Run the approved acceptance procedure only after the isolated pixel/runtime connection exists, with host logs and baseline/return evidence.

findings.finding: Authenticated owner mapping and cross-garden read/write rejection are absent. Service tokens do not establish private personal gardens. Public Site access is recorded in the import; it was not freshly queried in this audit.
findings.recommended_resolution: Add and execute two-owner isolation checks before a multi-user promise or release.
findings.recheck_trigger: Ownership layer or hosting audience changes.

findings.finding: Root README retained the pre-Wild 21-test backend count.
findings.resolution: Current evidence now reports 80 cases; historical import records remain explicitly historical.

findings.finding: agent_scores(limit_per_agent=20) still aggregates all scored recommendations; the parameter does not select a historical window. Contribution scores are not causal or real-world agent performance.
findings.recommended_resolution: Choose and document score-window semantics before implementing candidate comparison or promotion.
findings.recheck_trigger: Agent replay, trial or promotion is implemented.

findings.finding: The Wild dashboard snapshot reads world state, event cursor and agent summaries in separate queries; concurrent progression can mix summary revisions.
findings.recommended_resolution: Use one consistent read snapshot in the future pixel adapter; current read-only behavior remains verified.
findings.recheck_trigger: A coherent pixel snapshot contract or active-update dashboard consistency becomes required.
